title: Kat Von D releases electrifying fury with “I Am A Machine” Featuring Alissa White-Gluz
htmlContent:
Kat Von D is back with a bang! Her new single, “I Am A Machine,” is an exciting mix of dark disco vibes and catchy synth sounds inspired by the energetic music of the 80s. Co-written with Ferras, who has worked with big names like Dua Lipa and Katy Perry, this song has a powerful beat and an emotional touch that makes it both captivating and relatable.

Von D’s sultry voice shines through layers of shimmering sounds and deep bass. The song explores themes of love and loss in a digital world, and her passionate delivery adds a personal touch that resonates with listeners. Joining her is Alissa White-Gluz, the fierce vocalist from Arch Enemy, whose powerful growl brings a striking contrast and takes the song to new heights. Their collaboration creates a thrilling blend of elegance and intensity, embodying the song’s theme of combining the mechanical with the heartfelt.

https://open.spotify.com/track/0Nc3jk9EytgeEmQGXMP2Iw?si=U44-KYuhR1ecv2FNUfMmuw

Von D embraces a beautifully dark style, and “I Am A Machine” perfectly showcases this. It’s a song that both enchants and empowers, drawing you in with its captivating atmosphere and the exhilarating energy of White-Gluz’s vocals. Ultimately, while this song has a strong, robotic feel, it also carries a deep emotional core that makes it truly unforgettable.
